sources.title: CyArk: Bagan heritage documentation project
sources.note: Direct project introduction, approximate1044 to 1287 central role, late1200s political/economic decline and successor city-states; continuing functioning temples. Monument totals omitted.

sources.title: Rila Mukherjee: Silver Links! Bagan, Bengal and Shadowy Metal Corridors (2017)
sources.note: Publisher original extract, Enigma of Bagan, explicitly state-directed religion/labour/building/trade and links with agriculture. Group whole Bagan and the World conservatively with existing Arakan Mya Oo chapter. No unsupported detailed silver itinerary.

sources.title: Sanda Linn: Architecture of the Htilominlo Temple (2014)
sources.note: Direct university repository abstract. Early13thcentury, two storeys, solid core, entresol, sandstone within brick. Do not use contested exact1211/1218 date or miraculous umbrella succession story as fact.

sources.title: Gyles Iannone, Pyiet Phyo Kyaw and Scott Macrae: Residential patterning, agriculture and water at Bagan (2019)
sources.note: Downloaded full10-page conference paper; pp1 to 4 city includes peri-urban settlement outside regal/ritual walled epicentre; vulnerable domestic traces and biased monument research. Preliminary research design, not final results.

sources.title: IRAW@Bagan: Shwe Creek excavations, Operation 315a
sources.note: Original academic project report checked in full indexed result, direct web fetch failed. Three early/middle/late phases; calibrated dates1045 to 1216 and1254 to 1295. Plastered/tamped floors, postholes, pottery anvils/spacer support combined habitation and pottery manufacture as interpretation.

sources.title: Bob Hudson, Nyein Lwin and Win Maung: The Origins of Bagan, New Dates and Old Inhabitants
sources.note: Full original Asian Perspectives40(1), pp48 to 74 downloaded and extracted. Printed58 sprinkler pots and over50surface spouts;59 possible latrine lining, pig teeth/ruminant bones in880 to 1030layer; excavated tubes not securely13thcentury. Publication volume labelled2001, copyright2002; omit conflicting year from title.

sources.title: Elizabeth Moore, U San Win and Pyiet Phyo Kyaw: Water Management in the Urban Cultural Heritage of Myanmar (2016)
sources.note: Full journal PDF inspected pp294 to 300; moat above river level, rainwater systems and inward development. Existing mon-state references same work; combined budget and original overview provenance checked. No medieval household sewage system inferred.

sources.title: Than Tun: Social Life in Burma, AD 1044 to 1287, pp. 37 to 47
sources.note: Original11-page image scan downloaded; printed39 to 45 visually checked. Family terms, rice/curry cooks, midwives and musicians, inherited and traded slavery,1291carestipulation. Rejected author’s unsupported benevolent-slavery generalizations and language of contented slaves. Paper read31December1958; citation catalogues vary on issue year.

sources.title: Rachelle Saruya: Creating Demand and Creating Knowledge Communities (2022)
sources.note: Original indexed full journal article, section2 cites medieval inscriptions for some literate enslaved women and religiously learned nuns; footnote4 says full ordination status debated. Later chronicles on popular grammar studies are not contemporary school statistics.

sources.title: E. Hultzsch: A Vaishnava Inscription at Pagan, Epigraphia Indica VII, pp. 197 to 198
sources.note: Original article mirrored; both pages downloaded. hultzsch52.html has p198 line1 Svasti śrî and translation Hail! Prosperity! Line4 repeats. Sanskrit in Grantha plus Tamil prose in Tamil script; Tamil letterforms assigned13thcentury, no exactyear. Published Roman transliteration used, not invented Unicode Grantha. Hultzsch used impressions1902/1903. Group entireEIVII with nextpage and JainQuantum scan032561.

sources.title: E. Hultzsch: Pagan inscription, text and translation, p. 198
sources.note: Downloaded HTML directly, verified full Roman transcription and English translation: hall, sacreddoor, fixedlamp constantlyburning; donorMalaiMandalam/Magodayarpattanam. Same work as p197.

sources.title: Donald M. Stadtner: Ancient Pagan, A Plain of Merit, in Buddhist Art of Myanmar (2015)
sources.note: Full Asia Society/Yale exhibition catalogue, printed55 to 63/PDF71 to 79. p55 rejects evidenceless total Mongol destruction; pp56/62 monumentgrowth and laterpainting; p63 Payathonzu13thcentury. No sweeping ethnicdisappearance or absolute politicalborders assertions inherited.
